opening: Anna arrives to help repair her brother's marriage after his affair. She knows how to soothe an injured wife and make a difficult household breathe again. Then she meets Vronsky, and the understanding she brings to other people's lives offers little protection in her own. Tolstoy follows desire into train stations, nurseries, drawing rooms, and the anxious intervals between meetings, making an attachment feel like an entire world while showing all the people and obligations that continue to exist beyond it.
